references.text: Miriam is called a prophetess, in the same way that Deborah is described as a female prophet in Israel.
Huldah was another female prophet in Israel, whom King Josiah consulted.
The Lord raised up judges to save Israel, and Deborah was one of these judges.
Deborah's song describes her as a mother in Israel who rose up to lead the people.
Anna is called a prophetess in the New Testament, a parallel to Deborah as a female prophet.
Samuel judged Israel in a similar way to how Deborah did, by traveling around and settling cases.
Philip's four daughters who prophesied show that women continued to have a prophetic ministry.
